sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 221 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 66 of 70 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included, 1-night minimum for campsites. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Cabins have their own 2-, 3- and 7-night minimums.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/robert-h-treman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=221 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Reservations for campsites may be booked 9 months in advance for a 1-night minimum stay'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/robert-h-treman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=221 ('Robert H. Treman State Park - 2027 Camping Season: Campsites: May 14 - November 6, 2027'; 2026: May 15 - November 7), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 30 of the 66 campsites parsed have electric: 20 with 30-amp (Loops One and Five), 10 with 50-amp (Loop Five); no full-hookup sites.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 221 ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 20, '50 amp' 10, 'Electric Hookup - no' 36, 'Full Hookup - no' 66), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 70 campsites plus 14 cabins; listed equipment lengths run 20-50 ft (20 sites at 50 ft), one 30-ft pull-through, the rest back-in.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/robert-h-treman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=221 ('Campsite (70)', 'Cabin (14)') + ReserveAmerica site list ('50 Back-In' 20, '30 Back-In' 11, '25 Back-In' 6, '40 Back-In' 4, '45 Back-In' 3, '30 Pull-Through' 1, '20 Back-In' 7 ...), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/robert-h-treman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=221 ('dumping stations ... restrooms with showers'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP, lower-park campground near Enfield Creek (Ithaca). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 221): 70 campsites, reservable, phone 607-273-3440. Added 9-month window incl. same day, 1-night minimum, 14-night max, 2027 season May 14 - Nov 6, electric to 50-amp at 30 sites (the note's '~11 electric' was wrong), lengths to 50 ft with one pull-through, showers, dump.
